description: This source file implements core data structures and functions for managing object data within a Git packfile system, including object lookup, rehashing, packing preparation, and manipulation of the in-pack object list.

methods.name: uint32_t locate_object_entry_hash(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid,int * found)
methods.description: Locates the index of an object by its object ID hash within the packing data index, indicating if the object was found.

methods.name: uint32_t closest_pow2(uint32_t v)
methods.description: Calculates the nearest power of two greater than or equal to the input value.

methods.name: void rehash_objects(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Rebuilds the hash index for the objects based on current objects count to improve lookup efficiency.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_find(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds an object in the packing data by its object ID.

methods.name: void prepare_in_pack_by_idx(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Prepares the in-pack object index mapping for efficient access.

methods.name: void oe_map_new_pack(struct packing_data * pack)
methods.description: Updates the packing data to include a new pack after packing data has been prepared.

methods.name: void prepare_packing_data(struct repository * r,struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Initializes the packing data structure with repository information and prepares in-pack indexing.

methods.name: void clear_packing_data(struct packing_data * pdata)
methods.description: Frees internal allocations of the packing data to clean up resources.

methods.name: struct:object_entry * packlist_alloc(struct packing_data * pdata,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Allocates a new object entry in the packing data, updating hash index and associated structures.

methods.name: void oe_set_delta_ext(struct packing_data * pdata,struct object_entry * delta,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Sets external delta extension information for an object, updating bases and delta indices.
